meta.subject: fix image stride = atomC, read data shift bug

en.summary: This commit fixes CSC image-read alignment for the exact-entry-stride case by treating only strides greater than one entry as jump cases and by using the full stride width in shift-counter updates.
why_it_counts: It changes only CSC image-read RTL logic.
The modified conditions directly decide whether the loader performs a jump read and how far response shift counters advance.
The commit message explicitly identifies a read-data shift bug at stride equal to atomC.
evidence: The patch changes jump and no-jump guards from pixel_x_byte_stride >= CSC_ENTRY_HEX to pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX.
The rsp_sft_cnt_l* update terms widen the stride slice from [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] to [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2:0].
Both changes are localized to NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v and affect the image read shift path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: If an image-read stride is exactly one buffer entry wide, the next access starts at the next clean entry boundary and should not be treated as a multi-entry jump. The loader should reserve the jump-read path for strides strictly larger than one entry. It must also update any rolling shift-position counters using the full stride width for the exact-entry case. Using an inclusive threshold or truncating the stride increment makes exact-entry traffic look like a jump or applies the wrong residual shift.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: exact-entry stride classification and shift-counter increment
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The pixel or element stride is exactly equal to the internal buffer entry width.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Classify stride-equals-entry as a jump case or truncate the stride increment when updating shift counters.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: inclusive boundary predicate and narrow stride slice
portability_notes: Target the path that decides whether to fetch an extra adjacent entry and how much of the buffered data to shift away.
The portable bug is boundary misclassification at equality, not only the specific constant name used in the source tree.
If another DUT tracks positions in elements rather than bytes, use the equivalent exact-one-entry comparison.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the predicate that enables an extra read or jump path when stride spans more than one buffer entry.
Change the strict-greater-than test to a greater-than-or-equal test so equality is misclassified.
In the shift-counter update path, reduce the stride increment to a narrower low-bit slice instead of using the full value needed for the equality case.
Leave downstream mask generation unchanged so the misclassified jump/shift propagates into visible data misalignment.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC image read jump gating and rsp_sft_cnt_l0/l1/l2/l3 increment logic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the jump threshold from >= entry to > entry and widens the stride slice used in rsp_sft_cnt_l* updates so exact-entry stride does not enter the wrong shift path.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v, change the 'pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX' guards back to '>=' and restore the narrower [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] stride slice in rsp_sft_cnt_l* increment expressions.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: When stride equals exactly one entry, the loader performs the wrong jump/shift behavior, producing misaligned image data or wrong residual-byte positioning.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes both the jump classification and the shift-counter update, which are the two places equality can be mishandled.
The commit message specifically names the exact-entry stride case.
No unrelated infrastructure or test files are touched.
notes: The equality boundary is the key semantic point for a cross-DUT reinjection.
Reintroducing either the inclusive threshold or the truncated increment is grounded, but restoring both best matches the source fix.

zh.summary: 该提交通过把 jump 情况限定为 stride 严格大于一个 entry，并在 shift 计数器更新中使用完整 stride 位宽，修复了 CSC 在精确一 entry stride 条件下的图像读对齐错误。
why_it_counts: 它只修改了 CSC 图像读取相关的 RTL 逻辑。
被修改的条件直接决定是否走 jump read 路径以及响应 shift 计数器推进多少。
提交信息明确指出 stride 等于 atomC 时存在 read data shift bug。
evidence: 补丁把 jump 和 no-jump 的条件从 pixel_x_byte_stride >= CSC_ENTRY_HEX 改成了 pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX。
rsp_sft_cnt_l* 的更新项把 stride 位切片从 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] 扩展到了 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2:0]。
这两处都只修改了 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中的图像读移位路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当图像读取 stride 恰好等于一个 buffer entry 宽度时，下一次访问会从下一个完整 entry 边界开始，不应被当成跨多个 entry 的 jump。加载器只应在 stride 严格大于一个 entry 时进入 jump-read 路径。同时，在这个精确等于一 entry 的场景中，任何滚动 shift 位置计数器也必须使用完整 stride 宽度来更新。若阈值采用包含等号的比较，或者更新时把 stride 截成过窄的低位，那么 equality 情况就会被误判为 jump，或者留下错误的残余 shift。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 精确一 entry stride 分类与 shift 计数增量
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 像素或元素 stride 恰好等于内部 buffer entry 的宽度。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 stride 等于 entry 也归类为 jump，或者在更新 shift 计数器时截断 stride 增量。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: inclusive boundary predicate and narrow stride slice
portability_notes: 应定位到决定是否额外抓取相邻 entry 以及要从缓冲数据中移掉多少内容的路径。
可移植故障的本质是等号边界分类错误，而不是源仓库中具体常量名。
如果其他 DUT 以元素而非字节计数，则用等价的“正好一个 entry”比较来映射。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 stride 跨越一个以上 buffer entry 时启用额外读取或 jump 路径的判断逻辑。
把严格大于测试改为大于等于测试，使 equality 情况被误判。
在 shift 计数更新路径中，不再使用 equality 情况所需的完整 stride 值，而是缩回较窄的低位切片。
保持下游 mask 生成不变，让错误的 jump/shift 判断自然传播为可见的数据错位。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 图像读 jump 门控与 rsp_sft_cnt_l0/l1/l2/l3 增量逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 jump 阈值从大于等于一个 entry 改成严格大于一个 entry，并扩展了 rsp_sft_cnt_l* 更新时使用的 stride 位切片，避免 exact-entry stride 走错移位路径。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中，把 'pixel_x_byte_stride > CSC_ENTRY_HEX' 改回 '>='，并在 rsp_sft_cnt_l* 增量表达式中恢复旧的 [NVDLA_BPE_LOG2-1:0] 窄位切片。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 stride 恰好等于一个 entry 时，加载器会执行错误的 jump/shift 行为，导致图像数据错位或残余字节位置错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁同时修改了 jump 分类和 shift 计数更新，这正是 equality 情况最容易出错的两个位置。
提交信息明确点名了 exact-entry stride 场景。
没有任何无关的基础设施或测试文件被修改。
notes: 跨 DUT 重新注入时，关键点是“等于边界”的语义。
只恢复其中一处也有依据，但两处同时恢复最接近源提交修复前的行为。
